about: Toucan Bill feature video capture pack. Demo business: Glow Nails Belmopan (made up). App clock frozen at Wed 18 Nov 2026, 10:41 AM, Belize. Phone stills are 1179x2556 (iPhone 15 Pro, 393x852 @3x). Recordings are 1178x2556 at 30 fps (1px of plain background cropped from the right edge because H.264 needs an even width). PDF renders are 300 dpi.
captureOnly: navigator.share is stubbed to record its payload (03-share-payload.json); no share sheet opens in headless Chrome.

navigator.storage.persist/persisted return true, because headless Chrome never grants persistent storage; on an installed phone app it is normally granted. Affects only the 'Storage: protected' line in 15-backup.png.
Scrollbars and focus outlines hidden; a soft gray tap circle is drawn in recordings only.
Font is the Windows system font (Segoe UI). On an iPhone the app shows San Francisco.
